description_en: Queries the details of all data nodes (Data Nodes) in a PolarDB-X instance, including node status, storage usage, and network addresses, to facilitate operations management and monitoring
description_zh: 该接口用于查询PolarDB-X实例中所有数据节点（Data Nodes）的详细信息，包括节点状态、存储使用情况、网络地址等，便于运维管理和监控
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx describe-polarx-data-nodes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --node-type dn --search-key pc-bp1c5w4fx00002274 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePolarxDataNodes

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页码。取值为大于0且不超过integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of nodes to query. Valid values:
- all: queries both dn and gms nodes.
- gms: queries only gms nodes.
- dn: queries only dn nodes
parameters.help_zh:
查询节点类型
- all: 表示同时查询 dn 与 gms 节点
- gms: 表示只查询 gms 节点
- dn: 表示只查询 dn 节点
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword for filtering query results
parameters.name: search_key
